description: This file defines the SettingsViewModel class for an Android application. It manages user preferences related to cloud services, synchronization modes, and credentials, interfacing with repositories and utilizing coroutines for asynchronous operations.

classes.name: SettingsViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel that manages user preferences and interactions with cloud storage and synchronization settings within the notes application.

methods.name: setPreference
methods.description: Sets a user preference of a generic enum type, with logic to update sync mode based on cloud service selection.

methods.name: setPreferenceSuspending
methods.description: Suspending function to set a user preference asynchronously.

methods.name: getEncryptedString
methods.description: Retrieves an encrypted string preference as a Flow.

methods.name: setEncryptedString
methods.description: Saves an encrypted string preference in a coroutine scope.

methods.name: clearNextcloudCredentials
methods.description: Clears stored Nextcloud credentials and deletes related ID mappings.

methods.name: removeFileStorageIdMappingsIfNeeded
methods.description: Removes file storage ID mappings if the storage location has changed and the current cloud service is FILE_STORAGE.
